sourceText:
The Bacon Bowl
By: MyLastBite
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




5 slices of regular bacon each
Optional: Salad Greens to fill bacon bowl

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 400 2 Form the uncooked bacon around the mold (see photos) 3 Place in a pan (deep enough to catch grease) 4 Cook until just brown and crispy (turning pan once) 5 Allow to cool for a few minutes 6 Gently remove bacon bowl and continue to cool 7 Fill with salad or more bacon!
